high_board_rank.description: Cross-sectional dense rank of close-lock limit-up streak, descending.
high_board_rank.lag_rule: same_day_close_streak; after_open must lag by one session

is_market_high_board.description: Stock is tied for the market high-board streak on the date.
is_market_high_board.lag_rule: same_day_close_streak; after_open must lag by one session

limit_down_close_event.lag_rule: same_day_close_lock; after_open must lag by one session

limit_down_open_event.description: Open printed at or below the limit-down proxy/price.
limit_down_open_event.lag_rule: same_day_open_print; pre_open must lag by one session

limit_down_open_not_close.description: Opened limit-down but did not close locked limit-down.
limit_down_open_not_close.lag_rule: same_day_open_known_after_open; close component must lag for after_open signals

limit_down_touch_event.description: Intraday touched limit-down using low/limit proxy or TDXGP touch state.
limit_down_touch_event.lag_rule: same_day_intraday_low; after_open must lag by one session

limit_down_touch_not_close.description: Touched limit-down but did not close locked limit-down.
limit_down_touch_not_close.lag_rule: derived_from_same_day_touch_and_close; after_open must lag by one session

limit_up_close_event.lag_rule: same_day_close_lock; after_open must lag by one session

limit_up_open_event.description: Open printed at or above the limit-up proxy/price.
limit_up_open_event.lag_rule: same_day_open_print; pre_open must lag by one session

limit_up_open_not_close.description: Opened limit-up but did not close locked limit-up.
limit_up_open_not_close.lag_rule: same_day_open_known_after_open; close component must lag for after_open signals

limit_up_touch_event.description: Intraday touched limit-up using high/limit proxy or TDXGP touch state.
limit_up_touch_event.lag_rule: same_day_intraday_high; after_open must lag by one session

limit_up_touch_not_close.description: Touched limit-up but did not close locked limit-up.
limit_up_touch_not_close.lag_rule: derived_from_same_day_touch_and_close; after_open must lag by one session

market_high_board.description: Market-wide maximum close-lock limit-up streak for the date.
market_high_board.lag_rule: same_day_market_max_streak; after_open must lag by one session

streak_gap_to_market_high.description: Market high-board streak minus stock close-lock streak.
streak_gap_to_market_high.lag_rule: same_day_close_streak; after_open must lag by one session

strict_rules.promotion: diagnostic until strict replay, global clustering, OOS/regime/marginal audit, and chain-lock update
strict_rules.tradability: open/close locked limit-up/down may be unfillable; use entry limit masks in replay
